name: Peach-Blueberry Pita Pizza with Ricotta, Basil & Pine Nuts

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 peaches
1 small pkg fresh basil
1 ½ (170 g) pkgs blueberries

instructions.primary_message: Quarter peaches lengthwise (around the pit); twist quarters to separate, then remove and discard pits. Slice each quarter into ¼-inch thick wedges. Place in a medium bowl.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add half to the bowl with the peaches. (Reserve remaining basil for later use.)
Peel, halve, and slice onion lengthwise into thin strips. Peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl along with blueberries, pine nuts, oil, salt, and pepper, then stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ medium red onion
3 cloves garlic
⅓ cup pine nuts
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Divide pitas between two baking sheet pans. Spread each with ricotta, then top with the peach mixture.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 whole grain pitas
1 ½ (425 g) pkgs ricotta cheese

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until peaches are tender and pizzas are warmed through, about 15 minutes.
When the pizzas are done, remove from the oven. Sprinkle with reserved basil, then drizzle with vinegar and honey. Cut into wedges.
To serve, divide pizzas between plates. Enjoy!
